description: This file defines backbone modules for object detection, including a custom frozen BatchNorm layer, backbone base class, ResNet backbone with frozen BatchNorm, and a joiner class for combining backbone outputs with position encoding. It also includes a function to build the backbone model based on provided arguments.

classes.name: FrozenBatchNorm2d
classes.description: A BatchNorm2d layer with fixed batch statistics and affine parameters, used to stabilize training with frozen normalization.

classes.name: BackboneBase
classes.description: Base class for backbone networks, managing intermediate layer extraction and output formatting.

classes.name: Backbone
classes.description: ResNet backbone with frozen BatchNorm, configurable via arguments.

classes.name: Joiner
classes.description: Sequential module that combines backbone features with position encoding outputs.

methods.name: _load_from_state_dict
methods.description: Loads state dict while removing 'num_batches_tracked' key if present.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs forward pass, applying normalization and returning nested tensors.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the backbone modules with specified configurations.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Processes input NestedTensor through backbone and returns feature maps with masks.

methods.name: build_backbone
methods.description: Constructs the backbone model with position encoding based on input arguments.
